claims.object_text: GluA3 subunit of AMPA-type glutamate receptors; excitatory neurotransmission in the central nervous system
claims.quote: The GRIA3 gene encodes the GluA3 subunit of AMPA-type glutamate receptors, which are crucial for excitatory neurotransmission in the central nervous system.
Pathogenic GRIA3 variants cause X-linked neurodevelopmental disorders of varying severity, including developmental delay, behavioral abnormalities, and epilepsy.

novel de novo GRIA3 missense variant (c.1969A > G; p.Thr657Ala)

Here, we present the case of a seven-year-old female patient presenting with developmental delay, spastic gait, and non-convulsive status epilepticus (NCSE), who was found to carry a novel de novo GRIA3 missense variant (c.1969A > G; p.Thr657Ala).

claims.object_text: severe epilepsy (in females with de novo variants)
claims.quote: This case expands the clinical and molecular spectrum of GRIA3-related disorders, demonstrating that females with de novo variants may experience severe epilepsy.

claims.object_text: first reported case of NCSE in a female patient with a GRIA3 variant
